title: AC1021 lineweights four-VIEWPORT and strict whole-source output
scope: Qualify one existing AC1021 source profile's four paper-space VIEWPORTs and the resulting strict ASCII whole-source conversion. This is not producer-wide or native-consumer qualification.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local input; producer and author are not independently authenticated. No DWG or DXF fixture is committed.

specification.authority: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.use: Bounds the modeled entity-specific fields; ownership is established from source LAYOUT membership and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD links.

sourceRelations: LAYOUT 0x102 (ISO A4 Size) lists VIEWPORTs 0x104 and 0x105 and owns paper-space BLOCK_RECORD 0x103.
LAYOUT 0x108 (Letter Size) lists VIEWPORTs 0x10A and 0x10B and owns paper-space BLOCK_RECORD 0x109.
The two paper-space BLOCK_RECORDs point back to their respective LAYOUTs. All four records are type 34; layer handles resolve to 0x10 or 0x2D and visual-style handle 0x208.
independentCrossCheck.limit: Peer agreement is corroborating transport evidence, not semantic or producer qualification.

implementation.summary: Added a separately guarded four-VIEWPORT AC1021 profile. For parentless deferred paper-space entities, strict source validation and output projection resolve the owner through the unique LAYOUT.viewportHandles entry, the LAYOUT paperSpaceBlockRecordHandle, and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD.layoutHandle. Explicit parent handles remain checked. The canonical *PAPER_SPACE lookup is retained only as a legacy fallback for unlisted entities. The profile validates the source container/parent relation, layer and visual-style dependencies, optional handles, and per-layout output identity mapping.

validation.selectorResult: PASS, exit 0. ASCII and Binary selected outputs are freshly imported. All four source VIEWPORT identities and modeled fields are checked against the exact LAYOUT member list and output owner; layer/style roles and absent optional links are checked; derived groups 68/69, atomic invalid-field refusal with destination preservation, and same-adapter correction/retry are covered. All 49/49 opaque source callbacks are qualified by this source's strict export path.
validation.strictWholeSourceResult: PASS, exit 0; CLI reports successful conversion and creates the DXF output.
